0022600193.text: The Orlando Magic (2-6, 0-4 at home, 2-2 on the road) arrive on a three-game losing streak, sitting 12th in the East and 5th in the Southeast, 3 games back. The Golden State Warriors (6-3, 4-1 at home) have won six straight and sit 2nd in the Pacific, 1 game back, and are without Jimmy Butler III (knee surgery), Kristaps Porzingis (illness) and Moses Moody (knee surgery), with Draymond Green (elbow), Gary Payton II (calf) and Gui Santos (knee) listed as day-to-day game-time decisions. Orlando is missing Paolo Banchero (ankle sprain), Jalen Suggs (knee), Izaiyah Nelson (ankle surgery), Jonathan Isaac (knee) and Noah Penda (hamstring strain) in this first meeting of the 2026-27 season, after the teams split 1-1 in 2025-26, with Golden State winning the last meeting 120-97 in San Francisco on December 22, 2025.
